The '''Vatleria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> inside [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Region" />

{{Talesstart}}
The system contained the [[Death/Legends|dying]], dark, and [[Water/Legends|foggy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vatleria]], which was located near safer [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] worlds. Vatleria was long abandoned by its inhabitants before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rebel Four">{{Tales|9|The Rebel Four}}</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Following the [[Mission to Vatleria|mission]] to [[Vatleria]] in "[[The Rebel Four]]," the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ends with the statement that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] will fulfill his wish for [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon, referencing his [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|Rescue of Princess Leia]] in {{Film|IV}}, which takes place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> due to Vatleria's proximity to thriving colonies, the Empire began to establish a base within the [[stone ruins]] of Vatleria, intelligence of which was passed from an [[Unidentified informant|informant]] to the Alliance team known as the [[Rebel Four]]. The team&mdash;led by [[F4-MF]] and including operatives [[Soo Rcharrz]], [[Falaem Onn]], and [[Grimgrim]]&mdash;[[Mission to Vatleria|travelled]] to the ruins, where they confirmed the presence of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and attacked. The Rebels were defeated by lethal traps activated by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Rebel Four" />

{{Talesend}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Vatleria first appeared in "[[The Rebel Four]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written and illustrated by [[Jay Stephens]] and published in the [[Star Wars Tales 9|ninth issue]] of the anthology series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''<ref name="Rebel Four" /> by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[October 10]], [[2001]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-458/Star-Wars-Tales-9-photo-cover|text=Star Wars Tales 9}}</ref> Although the story was not considered [[canon]]ical within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="Rebel Four" /> the star system where it took place was identified within the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-9.<ref name="TEA" /> Vatleria's name is an an anagram of [[Wikipedia:Latveria|Latveria]], the homeland of [[Wikipedia:Doctor Doom|Doctor Doom]], the antagonist of the [[Marvel Comics]] supehero team the [[Wikipedia:Fantastic Four|Fantastic Four]].<ref name="Latveria">{{Marvel|url=characters/doctor-doom-victor-von-doom/in-comics|text=Doctor Doom (Victor von Doom)}}</ref>
